components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary order/save action CTA (Thêm món, Lưu đơn, Lưu cài đặt) with 48px touch height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); color: #FFFFFF; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-jade-hover, #0A543D); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Exposed Buyer Bar (CustomerPicker)

components.css: .ds-buyer-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 320px; min-height: 54px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #D9E0DE); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); transition: border-color 150ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-buyer-bar:hover { border-color: var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); } .ds-buyer-bar:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-buyer-bar:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-buyer-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--status-paid-bg, #D1FAE5); color: var(--brand-jade-text, #0E6B4E); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-buyer-body { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-buyer-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary, #121917); } .ds-buyer-debt { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--status-debt-bg, #FEF3C7); color: var(--status-debt, #B45309); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

components.html: .000đ
components.css: .ds-vndk-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 220px; } .ds-vndk-input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 8px 66px 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #D9E0DE); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--text-primary, #121917); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-vndk-input:focus { border-color: var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); } .ds-vndk-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-vndk-suffix { position: absolute; right: 10px; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-secondary, #4B5854); }

components.css: .ds-product-card { width: 280px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-product-top { padding: 12px; } .ds-product-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary, #121917); } .ds-product-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-product-price { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--brand-jade-text, #0E6B4E); } .ds-product-unit { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary, #4B5854); } .ds-product-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 6px 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default, #D9E0DE); background: var(--bg-subtle, #EDF1F0); } .ds-product-qty-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, #4B5854); } .ds-stepper { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #D9E0DE); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); overflow: hidden; } .ds-stepper-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary, #121917); font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stepper-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle, #EDF1F0); } .ds-stepper-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-stepper-val { min-width: 44px; text-align: center; border-inline: 1px solid var(--border-default, #D9E0DE); line-height: 44px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--brand-jade-text, #0E6B4E); }

components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--glass-dock-bg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84)); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border, rgba(18, 25, 23, 0.10)); box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow, 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(14, 30, 25, 0.16), 0 2px 6px rgba(14, 30, 25, 0.06)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(165%); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(165%); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-dock-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 16px; color: var(--text-secondary, #4B5854); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-dock-item:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle, #EDF1F0); color: var(--text-primary, #121917); } .ds-dock-item:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-dock-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dock-active { background: var(--status-paid-bg, #D1FAE5); color: var(--brand-jade-text, #0E6B4E); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
PayTrack POS is designed around a calm, dependable home accounting notebook built for a Vietnamese online seller working from her phone and desk. Daytime order entry runs on soft jade-tinted paper with crisp flat white sheets so buyer addresses, item quantities, and VND totals stay effortless to scan between Zalo and Messenger chats. Evening profit and debt reconciliation shifts smoothly into deep eye-comfort slate rather than harsh pure black.

Across iPhone Safari PWA (375px) and Windows desktop (1280px+), the interface favors earned operational familiarity over decorative flair: 1px hairlines organize dense product grids and 12-column accounting rows, tabular monospace numerals align every VND figure vertically, and real-time translucent glass appears only on the top bar, sticky summary strips, and bottom Floating Glass Dock.
keyCharacteristics: Disciplined 60-30-10 color balance where Deep Forest Jade leads primary actions, active navigation, and profit figures.
Full-width desktop layout with no fixed left sidebar; a unified bottom Floating Glass Dock keeps 100% horizontal space open for the 12-column sales ledger.
Clean Vietnamese diacritics in Be Vietnam Pro paired with tabular JetBrains Mono for VND amounts, order codes, quantities, and dates.

Home-workflow ergonomics: exposed buyer bar with phone/address/debt preview, thousand-VND .000đ shorthand inputs, >= 44px touch targets, >= 16px inputs, and light-paper locked PNG receipts & VietQR cards ready for chat sharing.

rules.name: The 60-30-10 Restraint Rule
rules.body: Keep 60% calm canvas, 30% flat sheets and semantic glass, and <= 10% Jade or status accents; never flood inactive controls with saturated fills.

rules.name: The Chat-Ready Light-Paper Lock Rule
rules.body: Receipts and VietQR cards always apply .print-surface-light (sheet-surface + print-ink, color-scheme: light) even in Dark Mode.

rules.name: The iOS 16px Input Floor Rule
rules.body: Every input, select, and textarea renders at >= 16px (src/app/globals.css) so iPhone Safari never auto-zooms while logging orders.

rules.name: The Semantic Glass Only Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur lives strictly on .glass-dock and .glass-surface in src/app/globals.css with reduced-transparency fallbacks; never scatter raw backdrop-blur or shadow-lg in TSX.

dos: Do consume CSS custom properties from src/app/globals.css (--bg-canvas, --bg-surface, --brand-jade, semantic status tokens) so Light and Dark themes transition cleanly in 280ms.
Do format every VND amount, profit, debt, and date with .font-mono-tabular (tabular-nums) and maintain >= 44px touch targets and >= 16px form controls.
Do wrap shareable PNG receipts and VietQR cards in .print-surface-light, and pair every route with layout-matched skeletons and FetchErrorCard retries.
donts: Don't introduce banned AI-slop styles (indigo-, purple-, bg-clip-text, Sparkles, animate-bounce, tracking-widest) or scatter raw backdrop-blur, shadow-lg, rounded-2xl, or rounded-3xl in TSX files.
Don't add a fixed desktop left sidebar that squeezes the 12-column sales ledger, or add decorative numbered eyebrows (01, 02, 03) and generic marketing copy.
Don't use pure #000000 dark grounds or define conflicting color/blur tokens outside src/app/globals.css.
